title: CogRAG: Tackling Heterogeneous Cognitive Demands in RAG via Stratified Retrieval and Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2604.25928v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks typically process all queries through a one-size-fits-all pipeline, ignoring the heterogeneous cognitive demands of different tasks. This cognitive-blind approach causes two failure modes: cascading errors when low-level factual gaps trigger hallucinated reasoning, and reasoning-answer inconsistency in higher-order analytical tasks. We introduce CogRAG, a training-free, domain-agnostic framework that tackles these heterogeneous cognitive demands via stratified retrieval and reasoning. Inspired by Bloom's Taxonomy, CogRAG uses the predicted cognitive load of a query as a central control signal that coordinates two modules: Cognition-Adaptive Evidence Refinement supplements missing context via fact-centric or option-centric paths, and Cognition-Stratified Structured Reasoning replaces unconstrained chain-of-thought with cognition-aligned reasoning templates. We evaluate CogRAG on a demand

translated_title: CogRAG：通过分层检索与推理应对RAG中的异构认知需求
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）框架通常通过一套统一的流水线处理所有查询，忽略了不同任务的异构认知需求。这种“认知盲”的处理方式会导致两种失败模式：低层次的事实缺口引发幻觉推理从而产生级联错误，以及在高层次分析任务中出现推理与答案不一致的问题。我们提出了CogRAG，这是一个无需训练、领域无关的框架，通过分层检索与推理来应对这些异构认知需求。受布鲁姆分类学（Bloom's Taxonomy）启发，CogRAG将查询的预测认知负荷作为核心控制信号，协调两个模块：认知自适应证据精炼模块通过以事实为中心或以选项为中心的路径补充缺失的上下文；认知分层结构化推理模块用与认知对齐的推理模板替代无约束的思维链。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CogRAG是一个无需训练、领域无关的RAG框架，它以查询的预测认知负荷为核心控制信号，协调认知自适应证据精炼和认知分层结构化推理两个模块，解决了统一流水线处理异构认知需求所导致的级联错误与推理-答案不一致问题。
en_tdlr: CogRAG is a training-free, domain-agnostic RAG framework that uses the predicted cognitive load of a query as a central control signal to coordinate cognition-adaptive evidence refinement and cognition-stratified structured reasoning, addressing cascading errors and reasoning-answer inconsistencies caused by one-size-fits-all pipelines.
